title: Onboarding image test reopens a freshly copied executable for append and fails with a Windows sharing violation (os error 32)
outcome: federation_onboarding_running_image_identity_survives_rename_replacement creates its replacement image without reopening a just-written executable, so external scanners holding a new .exe cannot make it fail, while it still proves exactly the same onboarding identity behaviour.
acceptance: The test creates the replacement image in a single create-and-write of the exact intended bytes (the original image plus the trailer), with no reopen of a just-written executable; every existing assertion (original running image identity, distinct replacement bytes, both modes) is unchanged.
No retry loop, sleep, timeout change, ignore or skip is added, and production code is unchanged.

A focused run of the federation_onboarding_image tests passes on the exact final input, the independent review pair finds no Medium or higher, and the maintained full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
